name: File Organizer MCP
description: A powerful, security-hardened MCP server for intelligent file organization. Provides high-level atomic tools for organizing files into categories, detecting duplicates, extracting EXIF/ID3 metadata, scheduling automatic organization, and more — for use with Claude, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.
